configuration.parameter_status: Residential aggregate parameters developed on seven raw SHEERM houses; commercial hourly anchors from predeclared BDG2 development buildings; domestic program shapes from REFIT houses 3/5. Independent identities held out. Transfer weights, service activities, occupancy, charging, flexibility and other behaviour remain scenario priors, not a Portuguese population fit.

linen_reference.status: Portuguese manufacturer sheet, not Portuguese field data. Only cold-water 60C full load is a measured specification. Load fraction, 40C scaling, power-adjusted duration and profile shape are engineering priors. Installed 4.6 kW unchanged; no unaccounted hot-water heat.

empirical_moment_target.scope: Published BT totals 1.32+0.01 interruptions and 69.70+0.87 minutes. Moment matching for exposed cohort, excluding controlled stress. Not a fitted event-duration distribution, local/common decomposition or Lisbon-specific reliability model. 15-minute representation cannot reproduce sub-15-minute interruptions.

preserved_controls: OMIE nonnegative price and 0.8 local ratio

commercial.parameter_status: Portuguese office published mean and three small-commerce audit means inform annual scenario budgets. Weak cohort transfer and dispersion remain explicit priors; other sector annual/hourly anchors remain BDG2 development transfer. Independent discrete presence is not empirically calibrated. All annual building budgets include fixed and controlled appliance requests once, exclude EV charging.

office.status: Published 2019 billed cohort mean; 104 total sites, 58 with area. Corporate offices, not nationally representative gross end use. Dispersion is a prior.

retail.status: Five general retail audits; geometric half-transfer from immutable inventory due size/year mismatch.

cafe.status: Two small catering audits; geometric half-transfer, not population calibration.

grocery.status: Two refrigerated retailers, approximately 36 and 80 m2 vs synthetic 500 m2. Half-transfer scenario; cannot represent a fully calibrated supermarket.

presence.status: Explicit scenario priors. No comparable measured Portuguese commercial occupancy series found. Staff shifts, client turnover and persistent residents are separate processes; energy noise cannot generate people.
presence.care_visiting_status: Explicit 10:00-20:00 scenario prior, independent of 24/7 residents and staff. No claim of Portuguese regulatory or population visiting hours.

commercial.between_building_status: Log-space population standard deviation of the small published Portuguese audit values for retail/cafe/grocery; descriptive only and attenuated by transfer weight. Other sectors 0.30, office 0.25 are scenario priors. Stable by physical member across years; not nationally estimated dispersion.

empirical_validation: Residential aggregate developed on seven raw SHEERM houses, six held out. Commercial annual budgets incorporate Portuguese office/small-commerce references with explicit boundary/transfer uncertainty; discrete occupancy remains a prior. Commercial hourly anchors use BDG2 development buildings, domestic programmes use REFIT houses 3/5; separate identities held out. FIKElectricity is a professional-kitchen structural diagnostic. See empirical_validation.json and commercial_appliance_validation.json for explicit cohort mismatches and unvalidated priors. EV Norwegian measured sessions do not validate arrival SOC. Outage exposed-cohort moments anchored to E-REDES BT 2024; stress excluded.
forecast_method: Causal daily persistence + latest anomaly with 6h exponential decay; benchmark, not a fitted operational forecast
